tvShow.name: The Traitors
tvShow.overview: The entertainment industry’s most competitive reality stars and famous faces play the ultimate murder mystery game. Hosted by award-winning actor Alan Cumming at an ancient castle set deep in the Scottish Highlands, contestants work together on a series of exhilarating missions to build a prize fund worth up to $250,000. Hidden amongst the Faithful are the Traitors, whose goal is to eliminate the Faithful and claim the prize for themselves.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Twenty of America’s most cunning contestants, a mix of famous faces and everyday Americans, play the ultimate murder mystery game. Hosted by award-winning actor Alan Cumming at an ancient castle in Scotland, they will work together on exhilarating missions to build a prize fund worth up to $250,000. But hidden amongst the Faithful contestants are the Traitors, whose goal is to eliminate the Faithful and claim the prize for themselves. Under the cover of darkness, the Traitors will murder the Faithful one by one in a treacherous spree while the players try to uncover the Traitors and banish them from the game. If the Faithful contestants banish all the Traitors, they will share the prize fund, but if a Traitor makes it to the end, they will steal all the money.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Season 3 continues the thrilling competition with an all-celebrity cast, filmed at Ardross Castle in the Scottish Highlands. This season introduces unique twists and challenges, as contestants navigate alliances and betrayals in their quest for victory.

episodes.name: Let the Cards Fall as They Will
episodes.overview: Another new all-star cast arrives in Scotland at night and the game starts faster than ever before.

episodes.overview: Some overwhelming evidence is brought to the roundtable; the Traitors must murder in plain sight.

episodes.name: Show Me Your Faces

episodes.overview: The Faithful plan a coup and one Traitor is accused to their face; the roundtable brings difficult decisions; with the temperature in the turret at its boiling point, the Traitors must pull off the bloodiest murder the castle has ever seen.

episodes.name: The Black Banquet
episodes.overview: A bloody banquet shakes the whole castle; Traitor trust teeters; the mission means a trek to the epic Fyrish Monument, where one player wins a great power; alliances are tested at the roundtable.

episodes.name: A Queen Never Comes Off Her Throne

episodes.name: Do You Know the Enemy?

episodes.name: Leap of Faith

episodes.name: Reunion
episodes.overview: Host Andy Cohen talks with the Season 4 cast of "The Traitors" about their time in the castle.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: In its most treacherous season yet, The Traitors returns to Ardross Castle, where a fresh lineup of reality heavyweights descend into a game of secrets, sabotage, and psychological warfare. Host Alan Cumming presides over every twist with theatrical menace as Faithfuls hunt for hidden Traitors and Traitors quietly pick them off one by one. Alliances crumble, paranoia surges, and one shocking mid-season moment threatens to upend the entire game.
